title: Thieving Hopper

moves.title: Thievery
effects: Steal a card from the player's deck

move_pattern: Thievery → Flutter → Hat Trick → Nab → Escape → Escape (repeats)
notes: Thieving Hopper alternates between grounded and hovering states. The Flutter move applies the hover state, which changes the monster's animations and attack behavior. Once it enters the Escape move, it loops that move indefinitely to flee combat. The Thievery move prioritizes stealing Uncommon cards first, then Common/Rare/Event cards, then Basic/Quest cards, and finally Ancient or Imbued cards from the player's deck.
